Non-Linear Structural Benchmarking of 3D Printed Titanium TPMS Lattices for Patient-Specific Orthopaedic Scaffold Design

High AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation Patient-specific
Aaron Vance, Oluwarotimi Lawal, Abul Arafat, Abhishek Gupta, John Robinson et al. Bioprinting 2026-08-01 10.1016/j.bprint.2026.e00498
单位: Additive Manufacturing Research Group, University of Wolverhampton, Telford Innovation Campus, Telford TF2 9NT, UK
通讯: Aaron Vance @ Additive Manufacturing Research Group, University of Wolverhampton, Telford Innovation Campus, Telford TF2 9NT, UK
相关性: 该论文直接针对3D打印钛合金TPMS点阵结构进行力学性能表征与多准则优化，与AM生物医用材料方向高度相关。
边界: 该论文未涉及应力遮挡或刚度匹配的定量分析，也未报告疲劳性能、表面粗糙度或骨整合相关数据。
动机· 为患者特异性骨科支架设计提供系统化的TPMS点阵结构实验基准。
方法· 制备54种Ti-6Al-4V TPMS点阵，进行准静态压缩测试，结合AHP-TDD-TOPSIS框架进行多准则排序。
结果· 弹性模量6.3-107 GPa，屈服强度125-1030 MPa，壁厚和单元尺寸显著影响力学性能，Diamond和Split-P能量吸收更高。
验证· 通过准静态压缩实验验证，并与Gibson-Ashby模型对比。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To provide systematic experimental benchmarking of TPMS lattices for guiding patient-specific orthopaedic scaffold design.
Method· Fifty-four Ti-6Al-4V TPMS lattices were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion and tested under quasi-static compression, with results integrated into a hybrid AHP-TDD-TOPSIS decision-making framework.
Result· Effective modulus ranged from 6.3 to 107 GPa and yield strength from 125 to 1030 MPa, with wall thickness and unit cell size strongly influencing mechanical behavior; Diamond and Split-P lattices showed higher energy absorption than Gyroid.
Validation· Validation was performed through quasi-static compression testing and comparison with Gibson-Ashby scaling predictions.

单位: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, University of Washington, Seattle, WA, USA
通讯: Dwayne Arola @ Department of Materials Science and Engineering, University of Washington, Seattle, WA, USA
相关性: 该论文直接研究LPBF Ti6Al4V的疲劳性能与缺陷关系，对AM生物医学植入物的疲劳评估具有直接参考价值。
边界: 该论文未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合，也未进行生物医学背景下的植入物验证。
动机· 量化LPBF Ti6Al4V中缺陷对疲劳寿命的贡献，以提升疲劳寿命预测准确性。
方法· 采用定量断口分析，结合缺陷特征与疲劳寿命数据建立关联模型。
结果· 揭示了缺陷类型、尺寸和位置对疲劳寿命的定量影响，为工艺优化提供依据。
验证· 通过疲劳试验和断口分析验证了缺陷-寿命关联模型的有效性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To quantitatively link process-induced defects to fatigue life in laser powder bed fusion Ti6Al4V, aiming to improve fatigue life prediction and process control.
Method· Quantitative fractography was employed to characterize defect populations and correlate them with fatigue life data using statistical models.
Result· The study quantified the contributions of different defect types, sizes, and locations to fatigue life, providing a basis for defect-tolerant design.
Validation· The proposed defect-life relationship was validated through fatigue testing and post-mortem fractographic analysis.

相关性: 该综述系统梳理了AI在生物打印各阶段的应用，包括伤口诊断、生物墨水设计和打印优化，并提出了闭环系统，对AI驱动生物打印的研究方向具有直接参考价值。

Method· This review systematically examines the integration of artificial intelligence with 3D bioprinting across wound diagnosis, bioink design, and printing optimization.
Result· It proposes a closed-loop design-print-monitor-learn system to enable adaptive and personalized wound regeneration therapies.
Validation· As a review, it provides no experimental validation but synthesizes existing literature to outline future directions.

An asymptotic slender-body model for predicting print resolution in extrusion-based bioprinting

Medium AI for Bioprinting openalex Transferable Save for project in_vitro Exp. validation
Amy V. Tansell, Galane; id_orcid 0000-0003-3032-9950 Luo, Paraskevi Diakourti, Nasim Mahmoodi, Lauren E.J. Thomas-Seale et al. Journal of Engineering Mathematics 2026-08-01 10.1007/s10665-026-10544-0
单位: Centre for Doctoral Training in Topological Design, University of Birmingham, Birmingham, B15 2TT, UK
通讯: Amy V. Tansell @ Centre for Doctoral Training in Topological Design, University of Birmingham, Birmingham, B15 2TT, UK
相关性: 该论文提出了一种基于渐近细长体理论的物理模型来预测挤出式生物打印中的丝径，虽未直接集成AI，但其模型可作为AI代理模型或数字孪生的物理基础，对生物打印工作流的前期参数优化有参考价值。
边界: This paper does not integrate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is a purely physics-based analytical model with no autonomous decision-making or experimental validation beyond a single material (Nivea Crème).
动机· 现有打印测试方法耗时且依赖特定材料，缺乏通用预测模型。
方法· 采用渐近细长体理论简化Navier-Stokes方程，建立预测挤出丝径的物理模型。
结果· 模型能预测丝径并识别可打印窗口，初步验证显示良好预测能力。
验证· 使用Nivea Crème进行气动挤出实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the limitations of time-consuming and material-specific print-and-test approaches by developing a generalized physics-based model for predicting filament diameter in extrusion bioprinting.
Method· An asymptotic slender-body model is derived by reducing the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in an arc-length coordinate system, incorporating power-law rheology to capture shear-thinning bioink behavior.
Result· The model accurately predicts printed filament diameters and identifies printable process parameter windows, as demonstrated by good agreement with experimental data.
Validation· Preliminary validation was performed using pneumatic extrusion of Nivea Crème, showing good predictive capability.

Method· A bioactive implant was developed by integrating NRP-1-loaded liposomes with a 3D-printed magnesium alloy porous scaffold to amplify magnesium-induced angiogenesis.

Validation· In vivo validation was performed using a rat ischemic bone defect model.

单位: Jiangsu Provincial Engineering Research Center for Laser Additive Manufacturing of High-Performance Components, College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astro
通讯: Dongdong Gu @ Jiangsu Provincial Engineering Research Center for Laser Additive Manufacturing of High-Performance Components, College
相关性: 该论文研究了LPBF工艺参数对WE43镁合金成形质量和力学性能的影响，虽未涉及多孔结构或应力屏蔽，但其工艺优化方法可迁移至生物医用植入物的增材制造。
边界: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, focusing instead on process optimization and static mechanical properties of a solid magnesium alloy.
动机· 镁合金因高反应性和高蒸气压，LPBF加工窗口窄，需优化激光能量密度以获得高质量和高性能。
方法· 在不同激光能量密度下制备WE43镁合金，分析成形质量、微观结构和力学性能，确定最优参数。
结果· 在185 J/mm³能量密度下，表面粗糙度约11.2 μm，孔隙率0.1%，抗拉强度329 MPa，延伸率6.1%。
验证· 通过实验测量表面粗糙度、孔隙率、显微组织和拉伸性能进行验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The high reactivity and vapor pressure of magnesium alloys narrow the LPBF processing window, necessitating optimization of laser energy density to achieve high quality and performance.
Method· WE43 magnesium alloy samples were fabricated at varying laser energy densities, and their forming quality, microstructure, and mechanical properties were systematically characterized.
Result· An optimal energy density of 185 J/mm³ yielded minimal surface roughness (~11.2 μm) and porosity (0.1%), with ultimate tensile strength of ~329 MPa and elongation of ~6.1%.
Validation· Validation was performed through experimental measurements of surface roughness, porosity, microstructure, and tensile properties.

Motivation· Conventional single-track printability maps fail to capture the influence of heat accumulation from overlapping tracks and part geometry on the acceptable process window.
Method· A multi-track, multi-dimensional process map framework is developed using simulations and metamodels to quantify process-window shifts as functions of scan strategy and thermal history.
Result· The framework predicts cooling-rate trends and associated microstructural effects, and demonstrates adaptive adjustment of laser power and hatch spacing to achieve desired microstructures.
Validation· Validation is performed by calibrating with single-track simulations and confirming predicted cooling-rate and microstructural trends through experiments.

边界: This paper does not report stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or surface roughness/as-built morphology, focusing instead on antibacterial and osseointegration properties.
动机· 解决钛植入体感染与骨整合难以兼顾的问题。
方法· 采用SLM制备梯度多孔钛植入体，并表面载碘实现抗菌与骨整合双重功能。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the clinical challenge of implant-associated infections while maintaining osseointegration in porous titanium implants.
Method· Gradient porous titanium implants were fabricated by selective laser melting and surface-loaded with iodine ions to provide sustained antibacterial release.

相关性: 该论文虽针对肿瘤切除后的同种异体骨移植重建，但其有限元方法、界面微动和应力分析可迁移至髋关节假体应力遮挡与稳定性研究。
边界: This paper does not address hip implant stress shielding, femoral stem design, or proximal femur Gruen zone analysis; it focuses on distal femoral allograft reconstruction.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare the mechanical environment of two distal femoral reconstruction techniques under identical conditions, aiming to explain differences in clinical complications.
Method· Two patient-specific finite element models were constructed from CT data, simulating a 150-mm distal femoral defect reconstructed with either a plate-fixed osteoarticular allograft or a cemented allograft-prosthesis composite, under a 400 N axial load.
Result· The osteoarticular allograft exhibited higher peak graft strain and greater interfragmentary motion compared to the allograft-prosthesis composite, which showed lower strain and micromotion due to load redistribution through the prosthetic stem.
Validation· The study is purely computational, with no experimental or clinical validation of the finite element predictions.

方法· 对比AB与HT试样，结合EBSD构建CPFFT模型分析相间应力应变分配。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The study aims to elucidate the microstructural mechanisms behind the ductility improvement of LPBF-fabricated Zr-2.5Nb alloy after heat treatment.
Method· As-built and heat-treated specimens were compared, and a crystal plasticity fast Fourier transform model was built from EBSD data to quantify phase-specific stress and strain partitioning.
Result· Heat treatment transformed acicular martensite into a lamellar α+β structure, increasing uniform strain from 4.02% to 6.94% while reducing strength, with β-Zr accommodating more strain and α-Zr carrying higher stress.
Validation· The model predictions were validated against room-temperature tensile tests and EBSD microstructural characterization.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The scarcity of certified materials in metal additive manufacturing necessitates efficient methods to identify process windows for new alloys.
Method· Machine learning models were trained on simulation and experimental data from AlSi10Mg and Al5000 series alloys to predict part density and extrapolate process windows for a novel Al7000 series alloy.
Result· Models achieved high accuracy for known alloys (RMSE ~1%, R2 ~0.9) but lower accuracy for the new alloy (RMSE 3-7%), yet qualitative process maps aligned with experimental high-density regions.
Validation· Validation was performed by comparing model predictions with experimental density data and qualitative assessment of process maps.

Motivation· The study aims to understand the creep damage mechanisms in LPBF 316H stainless steel under different post-build heat treatments.
Method· Creep tests were performed on LPBF specimens in as-built, stress-relieved, solution-annealed, and hot-isostatic-pressed conditions, with damage characterized via X-ray computed tomography and scanning electron microscopy.
Result· LPBF specimens exhibited lower creep ductility and crack growth dominated by large macro-cracks oriented at 45° to the load, contrasting with the ductile failure of wrought material.
Validation· Experimental validation was achieved through mechanical creep testing and microstructural characterization using XCT and SEM.

Motivation· Standard pushers for relativistic charged particles either lack symplectic structure or accumulate secular errors over long times, motivating a symmetry-preserving surrogate approach.
Method· A two-stage framework pairs a physics-informed neural network that learns a surrogate relativistic Hamiltonian with an explicit symplectic integrator based on Tao's extended phase space.
Result· The symplectic integrator keeps energy errors bounded for all time, while the learned surrogate remains the accuracy bottleneck, though a light-cone reformulation reduces error for laser cases.
Validation· The framework is validated on benchmark problems against Boris and Runge-Kutta pushers, with symplecticity measured via the first Poincaré-Cartan loop invariant.

边界: This paper does not address finite element analysis, surrogate modeling for mechanical systems, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on imaging inverse problems with plug-and-play inpainting networks.
动机· 为图像MAP估计中的局部伪影提供高效的不确定性量化方法。
方法· 将BUQO中的手工修复替换为卷积神经网络，结合Condat–Vũ迭代实现即插即用算法。
结果· 在MRI和CT模拟中验证了该方法能有效检测局部伪影。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The paper aims to provide an efficient uncertainty quantification method for testing local artifacts in MAP estimates in imaging, overcoming limitations of handcrafted inpainting.
Method· A plug-and-play algorithm is proposed that replaces the handcrafted inpainting in BUQO with a convolutional neural network, integrated into primal-dual Condat–Vũ iterations.
Result· The proposed method successfully detects local artifacts in simulated MRI and CT reconstruction problems.
Validation· Validation is performed via simulation cases on Fourier undersampling and Radon measurement operators in medical imaging.

相关性: 该论文涉及模型预测控制与优化，但未涉及工程仿真、生物力学或植入物设计，与用户研究方向关联度低。
边界: This paper does not involve any engineering simulation (FEA/FEM), biomechanics, implant design, or surrogate modeling; it focuses on energy storage control with MPC.
动机· 为光伏智能电网设计减轻电池负担的混合储能控制策略。
方法· 提出分层MPC控制分配，上层调度铅酸电池，下层控制磷酸铁锂补偿波动。
结果· 相比铅酸单独MPC，铅酸吞吐量降低66.5%，斜坡负担降低76.4%。
验证· 使用韩国Naju体育公园696小时实测光伏与负荷数据评估。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The paper aims to develop a control strategy for hybrid energy storage systems that reduces stress on lead-acid batteries while maintaining grid stability in photovoltaic-integrated smart grids.
Method· A hierarchical model predictive control (MPC) allocation strategy is proposed, where the upper layer schedules the lead-acid battery based on low-frequency net load and the lower layer uses LiFePO4 to compensate residual fluctuations.
Result· The proposed method reduced lead-acid throughput by 66.5% and ramp burden by 76.4% compared to lead-acid-only MPC, and by 38.4% throughput compared to rule-based control with only a 3.3% increase in grid power standard deviation.
Validation· The method was validated using 696 hourly samples of measured photovoltaic generation and load data from a real smart-grid site.

方法· 回顾性分析3865例患者，采用单因素和多因素回归确定输血预测因子。

Motivation· To identify predictive factors for perioperative transfusion in total hip arthroplasty to improve patient management and reduce complications.
Method· A retrospective analysis of 3,865 primary THA patients was conducted using univariate and multivariate logistic regression to determine transfusion risk factors.
Result· Transfusion rates decreased over time; female sex, surgical approach, longer operative time, higher ASA, and hemoglobin drop increased risk, while tranexamic acid and anti-inflammatory use reduced risk.
Validation· The study is validated through a large retrospective clinical dataset with statistical modeling.

边界: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or any biomechanical modeling; it is purely clinical outcome assessment without implant mechanics or FE analysis.
动机· 评估腰椎融合术后患者行全髋置换后髋部特异性PROMs与腰椎症状的不一致。
方法· 回顾性分析47例患者，配对比较术前术后多种PROMs，并记录腰椎症状。
结果· 髋部PROMs显著改善，但腰椎症状持续存在，提示PROMs可能未完全反映恢复。
验证· 基于临床回顾性数据，使用配对Wilcoxon检验。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate whether hip-specific PROMs accurately capture recovery in THA patients with prior lumbar fusion, given the potential discordance with persistent lumbar symptoms.
Method· A single-center retrospective study analyzed paired PROMs (HOOS Jr., PROMIS, UCLA, EQ-5D) from 47 patients (54 cases) with prior LSF undergoing THA, using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests and chart review for lumbar symptoms.
Result· Significant early improvements in hip-specific PROMs were observed, yet lumbar symptoms persisted in a notable proportion of patients over two years, indicating incomplete capture of recovery.
Validation· Clinical validation using retrospective patient data with paired statistical comparisons.

Effects of Combined Pericapsular Nerve Group and Iliohypogastric Nerve Blocks on Postoperative Pain and Opioid Consumption After Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Randomized Clinical Trial

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore clinical Exp. validation
Fredrik Fellert, Fredrik Sjövall, Gunnar Flivik, Andreas Ekman A&A Practice 2026-08-01 10.1213/xaa.0000000000002267
单位: Department of Anesthesia Trelleborg, Trelleborg Hospital, Trelleborg, Sweden
相关性: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术后的疼痛管理和神经阻滞效果，与髋关节植入物的生物力学、应力遮挡或有限元分析无关。
边界: This paper does not quantify femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it is purely a clinical trial on postoperative pain management.
动机· 评估PENG和髂腹下神经阻滞对全髋关节置换术后镇痛的效果。
方法· 随机对照试验，215例患者分为阻滞组和对照组，比较疼痛评分和 opioid 用量。
结果· 阻滞组未显示一致的镇痛优势，但全身麻醉患者中 opioid 消耗降低。
验证· 临床随机对照试验，多时间点疼痛评分和不良事件记录。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine whether adding pericapsular nerve group and iliohypogastric nerve blocks to multimodal analgesia improves postoperative pain control after total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A randomized clinical trial enrolled 215 THA patients, comparing pain scores and opioid consumption between those receiving the nerve blocks and those receiving standard analgesia alone.
Result· The nerve block group showed no consistent analgesic benefit, though opioid consumption was lower in a subgroup receiving general anesthesia, and sensory deficits were more frequent.
Validation· Validation was through a prospective randomized clinical trial with multiple pain assessments and adverse event monitoring.

通讯: Guiyuan Li @ State Key Laboratory of HVDC Transmission Technology, China Southern Power Grid Electric Power Research Institute Co., L
相关性: 该论文涉及电力系统控制，与用户的研究方向（生物打印、髋关节植入物、有限元代理模型、增材制造）无关。
边界: This paper does not involve any biomedical context, implant mechanics, FEA, or bioprinting; it is purely about power electronics control.
动机· 解决高渗透新能源下并网变流器暂态稳定性问题。
方法· 提出自适应混合同步控制，采用模型预测控制动态调整跟网与构网比例。
结果· 有效抑制频率和电压波动，增强暂态稳定性。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The paper addresses the transient stability challenges of grid-connected voltage-source converters under high renewable penetration.
Method· An adaptive hybrid synchronization control strategy is proposed, using model predictive control to dynamically adjust the grid-following and grid-forming control ratios.
Result· The method effectively suppresses frequency and voltage fluctuations, enhancing transient stability of VSCs.
Validation· The approach is validated through PSCAD/EMTDC simulations under various transient conditions.
